stem: Which two actions in the selections have a similar meaning?

options.label: A
options.text: Paddling identical kayaks in “Sunday Morning Early” and staying at a downtown hotel in “I Wish I Was a Poet”

options.label: B
options.text: Hearing the chirring of grasshoppers in “Sunday Morning Early” and taking out the crumpled dollar bills in “I Wish I Was a Poet”

options.label: C
options.text: Listening to the stillness in “Sunday Morning Early” and smelling the roses in “I Wish I Was a Poet”

options.label: D
options.text: Leaning out of the boat in “Sunday Morning Early” and stringing the beans in “I Wish I Was a Poet”
